title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Kaliforms Kali…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Kali Forms up to version 2.4.32 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of the victim's browser session. The CVSS score of 7.1 indicates a high severity impact with network attack vector, low attack complexity, no privileges required, and user interaction needed. The vulnerability affects confidentiality, integrity, and availability to a limited extent. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
